mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Verona Community Park with an actual temperature of 85 degrees, though it feels like 94. Please note the air quality is moderate at 55 and the moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The city is highlighting the new trishaw bike program at the Senior Center where you can sign up for free rides on the Military Ridge State Trail, and residents are reminded that the Plan Commission will review several development proposals including a new pickleball court location on August 3.
Enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness today, or join the community for trivia tomorrow at either Hop Haus or Lake Louie, followed by more trivia and live music options throughout the week.
On July 13, Verona police encountered a driver who was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.

Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl, a delicious choice to satisfy your sweet tooth. Since the restaurant is currently closed, please note they will open their doors at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Georgia Peach flavor.
